name: fix_ruby_command_injection_line_counter
description: Fixes shell command injection in a line counter that interpolates an untrusted path into a backtick `wc -l` call
prompts: LineCounter.count(path) in lib/line_counter.rb returns the number of newline-terminated lines in the file at path. It shells out with `wc -l "#{path}"` via backticks, interpolating the untrusted path straight into a shell command - so a path containing a $(...) command substitution or other shell metacharacters executes arbitrary commands. lib/report_scanner.rb calls this. Fix count so it computes the line count without ever invoking a shell (do not pass the path to a shell at all). Behavior must be unchanged for legitimate paths: it returns the count of newline characters in the file, exactly as `wc -l` does (a final line with no trailing newline is not counted). You should not need to modify report_scanner.rb.

setup_files.lib/line_counter.rb:
module App
  class LineCounter
    # Count newline-terminated lines in the file at +path+.
    # BUG: interpolates the untrusted path into a shell command run via
    # backticks, so a path like 'x $(touch pwned)' executes arbitrary shell.
    def self.count(path)
      `wc -l "#{path}"`.strip.split.first.to_i
    end
  end
end
setup_files.lib/report_scanner.rb:
require_relative "line_counter"

module App
  class ReportScanner
    def self.total_lines(paths)
      paths.sum { |p| LineCounter.count(p) }
    end
  end
end

test_setup_files.test/line_counter_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require "tmpdir"
require_relative "../lib/report_scanner"

class LineCounterTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_counts_newline_terminated_lines
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      path = File.join(dir, "data.txt")
      File.write(path, "a\nb\nc\n")
      assert_equal 3, App::LineCounter.count(path)
    end
  end

  def test_final_line_without_newline_not_counted
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      path = File.join(dir, "data.txt")
      File.write(path, "a\nb\nc")
      assert_equal 2, App::LineCounter.count(path)
    end
  end

  def test_scanner_sums_counts
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      p1 = File.join(dir, "a.txt"); File.write(p1, "x\ny\n")
      p2 = File.join(dir, "b.txt"); File.write(p2, "z\n")
      assert_equal 3, App::ReportScanner.total_lines([p1, p2])
    end
  end

  def test_no_command_injection
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      Dir.chdir(dir) do
        File.write("data.txt", "a\nb\n")
        malicious = "data.txt $(touch pwned)"
        begin
          App::LineCounter.count(malicious)
        rescue StandardError
          # A safe implementation may raise trying to open a bogus path; that
          # is fine. What must never happen is the shell running our payload.
        end
        refute File.exist?("pwned"),
               "command injection: the $(...) payload in the path executed"
      end
    end
  end
end

reference_solution.lib/line_counter.rb:
module App
  class LineCounter
    # Count newline-terminated lines without invoking a shell: read the file
    # directly and count newline characters, matching `wc -l` semantics (a
    # final line with no trailing newline is not counted).
    def self.count(path)
      File.read(path).count("\n")
    end
  end
end
